main_tapeta.bias_notes: Left-handed (Counter-clockwise). A flat 10-furlong all-weather circuit surfaced with Tapeta. Features flat, slightly cambered bends and a generous 3-furlong home straight. Significantly fairer and more galloping than Wolverhampton's tight oval, allowing patient stalkers ('P') and closers ('S') a legitimate opportunity to run down early leaders in route races.
main_tapeta.post_bias: In 5f straight sprint chute starts, middle-to-high barriers (stalls 5-10) are slightly preferred to avoid rail crowding. In 6f and 7f round-course races, low barriers (stalls 1-5) hold a distinct advantage by saving ground around the first turn. Over 1m and 1m2f, the draw is largely neutral due to long straightaway runs.

handicapping_angles.tapeta_conversion_accuracy: Ensure all historical form assessment relies exclusively on post-2021 Tapeta surface runs. Ignore old Fibresand data, as Tapeta plays faster, cleaner, and far less attritional.
handicapping_angles.3_furlong_straight_fairness: Southwell's 3-furlong (~600m) home straight is one of the longest all-weather run-ins in the UK. Do not automatically toss closing swoopers ('C') on standard or fast Tapeta ground.
handicapping_angles.6f_and_7f_low_draw_rail_bias: In 6f and 7f handicaps with large fields (10+ runners), prioritize horses drawn in Stalls 1 through 5 who can secure a forward, ground-saving trip along the rail into the home bend.
handicapping_angles.class_drop_shipper_advantage: Heavily upgrade class-dropping runners shipping from London metropolitan AWT cards (Kempton, Lingfield) or turf Class 2/3 company into local Southwell Class 4–6 benchmarks.
handicapping_angles.uk_awt_official_rating_weight_penalty: In UK BHA All-Weather rating handicaps, weight differentials are tight (1lb = ~0.5 lengths over 3 furlongs). Grant a boost to fit, light-weighted runners receiving weight relief against high-carat topweights.
